transmitter.board: RadiANT ANT+ compatible USB stick (nRF52840), serial 3D55F77818BE772A
transmitter.description: tools/ant_sim.py drove the stick as an ANT+ power master: device 14871, type 0x0B, transmission type 5, 8182 ticks (4.0049 Hz), 120 W, 80 rpm, RF 57. NOT sim/ on an nRF54L15 DK, which is what archive/benchmarks/2026-08-09-sdk-ant.json used - see notes.transmitter_differs.

receiver.antenna: onboard 2.4 GHz PCB antenna, board flat on the desk

link.interference: Mean RSSI -48.1 dBm (min -53, max -47) against a tracking threshold near -90, so about 40 dB of margin. A short bench path, not a sensitivity measurement.

notes.what_this_is: The B leg of the TI port's A/B, recorded on its own. It is a record of what the cc26xx backend measured, not a comparison.
notes.no_a_leg: THERE IS NO PAIRED A LEG AND THE GATES THEREFORE CANNOT BE RUN. docs/testing.md requires A/B/A in one sitting with the transmitter untouched, because the run-to-run spread on this bench is comparable to the effect being measured. The A leg needs a radiant_core nRF-backend receiver, and radiant_core's Kconfig scopes that backend to SOC_COMPATIBLE_NRF52X and SOC_COMPATIBLE_NRF54LX - so the nRF5340 DK on this bench cannot carry it, which its own build guard says out loud. The two candidates are the nRF54L15 DK and the Feather, and both need physical access: the L15's J-Link went into its bootloader during this sitting (see notes.probe) and the Feather needs a double-tap on RESET to expose its UF2 volume.
notes.probe: The nRF54L15 DK's onboard J-Link (SN 001057737173) is in DFU mode and enumerating as VID_1366 PID_0101 with status Error. Cause: a bare JLink.exe -CommanderScript was run against it without 'exec DisableAutoUpdateFW', so V9.66 tried to upgrade the onboard firmware and the emulator did not re-enumerate. scripts/flash_sim_jlink.ps1 exists precisely to prevent this and was not used. Recovery is a physical unplug and replug.
notes.transmitter_differs: The 2026-08-09 sdk-ant baseline was transmitted by sim/ on an nRF54L15 DK at RSSI -21 dBm. This run was transmitted by tools/ant_sim.py driving a USB stick at RSSI -48 dBm. Those are different transmitters, different sittings and 27 dB apart, so the two files must NOT be diffed as an A/B. They are recorded side by side only so a future sitting knows what to reproduce.
notes.gaps: sensitivity (needs an attenuator and a second receiver), acquisition (the sweep is 128 sets on this backend against 32 on the nRF - the regression is expected by construction and is to be recorded, not tuned), ack_data (no responder on the bench), conformance (not run this sitting).
